description:
Use this when you need an auditable Mexico working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when article 69 weekly rest is at least one day after six days and the employer/worker schedule is not inferred; sector, state, employer, school and bank calendars are outside scope.
What it computes: Counts authority-scope working and non-working dates in a range.
Example user requests: Count Mexico working days around Constitution Day observed.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-01-01","end_date":"2026-01-01","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/mexico-labor-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/mexico-labor-working-days-between.md
name: count_mx_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Mexico Federal Labour Law mandatory rest days

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: Article 74 mandatory rest days; first/third Mondays are represented by their statutory observed dates

substitute_day_policy.description: Election-day and six-year executive-transition dates are not inserted without the applicable electoral/constitutional schedule

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Mexico Working Days
